_comment: VibeCoded Orchestrator — VS Code tasks template. Belt-and-braces companion to the Claude Code SessionStart hook: it runs that SAME hook (session-start-ensure-hub) when the project folder is opened in VS Code, even when no Claude Code session has been launched yet. Since v0.2.95 the hook ensures THREE things, not one — vct-hub, the model gateway (only when one is registered for this project) and the launcher GUI (only when session-autostart is enabled) — each through its own vco_lib.*_ensure module. Every leg is idempotent: a live service is left alone and the leg exits 0 whether it started something, found it already running, or could not start it. Bypass with VCT_DISABLE_HOOKS=1 in your environment.

tasks.label: Start VCT Hub
tasks.detail: Idempotently ensure vct-hub, the model gateway and the launcher on folder open (hub since v0.2.21; gateway + launcher legs since v0.2.95).
